caption: The drawing features a metallic mechanical device with two circular open-ended cuffs, one on each side, connected by a straight horizontal bar. At the center of the bar, there is a vertically oriented cylindrical section with a large, oval-shaped handle at the top, colored in a brass or gold tone. The main body of the device appears to be rendered in a grey metallic color. The cuffs have small extensions with holes on opposite sides, with one side slightly open presumably for fastening. Above the main device, there are two technical sketches. The sketch on the left depicts a key-like object with specified dimensions, showing a simple design with a loop handle and a notched shaft. The sketch on the right shows another view of the oval handle, also labeled with dimensions, giving a closer look at the shape. The drawing overall is on a blank, cream-colored background, and the objects are rendered with colored pencils or similar medium, focusing on mechanical and structural accuracy.
title: Handcuffs with One Key
